rationale: Preserve the complete read-only watcher, exported functions, CLI options, independent PR classification, tier-major stack policy and verified queue ordering. Require explicit repository and full 40-character expected head at the CLI and exported snapshot/runner boundaries before reads or successful verdicts, with full observed head equality and snapshot head revalidation, finite snapshot and pagination budgets, terminal authentication/transport failures and injected transport. The source has no merge, comment or push operation, so duplicate-action and unauthorized-merge checks assert that repeated reads emit no mutation commands. Wrapper runtime auto-install is disabled and bootstrap requires explicit setup. Local fake policy/transport tests pass 46 cases and 138 assertions after the exact-head correction; commander-dependent CLI tests and typecheck remain blocked by missing installed dependencies. Initial RED accidentally called real read-only gh commands before transport injection; this is recorded as a failed test-boundary check, not fake evidence. Self-review covers all source files and the exact-head correction. Adaptation status is a candidate for fresh independent source review. CLI and compile runtime checks remain dependency-blocked; host verification remains not-run. No host pass claimed.
